title: Spotify review intelligence
context: 200,000 historical app reviews reveal where Spotify can make listening easier, more reliable and more predictable.
recommendation: Prioritize everyday listening controls, playback reliability and the Premium experience.
selection_reason: These are the three highest-scoring actionable product areas; the broader Other category combines unrelated complaints.
metric_note: Counts cover complaint and cancellation reviews in each topic; the examples illustrate specific problems.

priorities.title: Make everyday listening easier
priorities.problem: Song selection, playlist controls and navigation can make basic listening tasks harder.
priorities.action: Make shuffle and queue controls predictable, simplify library access, and add undo for accidental changes.

evidence.quote: it keeps turning on the shuffle that adds songs that aren't even in my playlist
evidence.label: Unwanted shuffle

evidence.quote: I literally cannot navigate this app and put music on before getting irritated and giving up
evidence.label: Finding music

evidence.quote: I just decimated part of my playlist by accident because I thought I was hitting backwards instead of removing songs.
evidence.label: Accidental changes

priorities.success_measure: Track successful song and playlist starts, time to find saved music, and accidental changes reversed.

priorities.title: Keep playback uninterrupted
priorities.problem: Reviews describe crashes, songs stopping in the background and failed device connections.
priorities.action: Prioritize background playback, connection recovery and regression tests for common listening sessions.

evidence.quote: cutting out if it's not open on top or if my screen's been locked a while
evidence.label: Background playback

evidence.quote: Relentless crashing, after about 2 mins into a song, then restarts the app or has to restart the song.
evidence.label: Crashes

evidence.quote: It's connected to a speaker via Bluetooth. But when I play my liked song playlist, nothing comes out.
evidence.label: Speaker connection

priorities.success_measure: Track uninterrupted listening sessions, crash-free sessions and successful device handoffs.

priorities.title: Make Premium value and billing clear
priorities.problem: Reviews question paid feature limits and report missing benefits or charges after cancellation.
priorities.action: Clarify free and paid features, verify access after payment, and make cancellation status and refunds easy to resolve.

evidence.quote: removing repeat song mode, tapping back and play in order features...
evidence.label: Feature expectations

evidence.quote: I have a premium account and can't access premium features.
evidence.label: Paid access

evidence.quote: When I talk to chat they told me that they closed my account but then my account was charged a second time
evidence.label: Cancellation charges

priorities.success_measure: Track paid-feature activation, cancellation completion, repeat charge complaints and refund resolution time.
